description.value: Organic Acres Market is a compact but fully stocked organic grocery store at the corner of Main Street and East 20th Avenue in Vancouver, part of the Be Fresh and SPUD.ca family of local food businesses. Despite its modest size, the store carries fresh organic produce, prepared to-go entrees and salads, and cold-pressed juices from The Juice Box. It is a convenient urban resupply stop for cyclists traveling the Main Street corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the OSM name, address (3603 Main Street), and phone number (604 569 1132). The store is described as 'fully stocked with the freshest and highest quality organic foods' including fresh organic produce, Be Fresh to-go entrees and salads, and cold-pressed juices, confirming it as a functioning organic grocery. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, racks, charging) are mentioned anywhere on the website.
concerns: The locations subpage (befresh.ca/about-us/vancouver-cafe-market-locations/) lists 'organicacresmain.com' as a separate website for Organic Acres, which differs from the OSM URL (befresh.ca/organicacres/). The alternate domain should be verified and potentially added to the listing.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A confirmed, active organic grocery store on a major Vancouver cycling corridor; useful resupply point for touring cyclists seeking fresh produce and prepared foods.
